svg.title: Two caches of the same prompt, with the edges that each of the three groups accepts marked under its row
svg.desc: Two panels, each with three rows of squares, one for the full group and one for each sliding group, and a square for each of the prompt's eleven blocks. A filled square is a cached block. A small bar under a row is an edge that the group accepts. In the first panel the three groups share one edge, marked by a vertical line. In the second panel they share none.

text.font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A: the sliding groups hold different runs
